citation: The Inland Architect and News Builder, vol. VIII, no. 3 (September 1886), p. 28, Chicago building news, Cobb & Frost notice for O. R. Keith, 1808 Prairie Avenue.
locator: Printed p. 28, right column near foot, paragraph beginning Architects Cobb & Frost report.
rights_note: Text published in the United States in 1886. Used as textual evidence; no scan-derived texture.
access_notes: Page image retrieved from the Prairie image store and visually read 2026-10-16. Library handle a18-inland-architect-1886-09-keith-notice.
note: The notice says: For O. R. Keith, three story dwelling, 38 by 80 feet, 1808 Prairie avenue, granite front; cost $40,000; John Angus, mason. It names granite but neither a quarry nor a colour. The 38-foot permit/design width is not used to move T-1882's accepted footprint.
